name: Pretend Internet
summary: Browse sites, play games and music, read books and publish to Nostr.
storage: Browser local storage for preferences and IndexedDB for local content and publish attachments.

help.purpose: A local-first place to find, open and keep sites, games, music and books.
help.start: Explore the bookshelf or add a public Nostr profile in the profile menu.
help.limitations: Relay, media and public site availability depends on network access. Signing requires a compatible provider.
help.data: Bookmarks, reading position, collections, cached events and draft files stay in this browser.
